programmes.d: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother?s honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

When Pastor Noble Jones's carefully constructed image begins to unravel, his wife Trezjiir is forced to confront not only the trauma of her past but the deceit poisoning her present. As buried secrets resurface-ranging from infidelity, hidden.
Rae Jones is a talented and edgy 20-something who is desperate to become an actress. After ages of dead-end auditions and exploitation in music videos, she finally gets the break of a lifetime.

Sole is a struggling fashion stylist who has one wish for Christmas and that's a chance for her career to level up. With her workplace being far from merry, and her plate full at home raising her niece and nephew, she feels like anything but a Queen.
When aspiring artists Niles and Mina are given the opportunity of a lifetime, they learn they share a secret.

Reeling from a recent break-up with his girlfriend of two years, Anderson Hunt, is convinced by his well-meaning friends to get back out on the dating scene, by using an app for alternative lifestyles.
A confused college student does not believe in love until a new project allows her to find it right under her nose.
A radio host (Brandon Queshawn) with a reputation for exaggeration tries to be truthful for the first time in his life, but the woman of his dreams may not believe him.
Love scammer Candy, promises her crew one last con before swearing off the game, but what happens when the target turns out to be "the one".
Brandon's world is turned upside down when he receives a phone call from Maurice, revealing himself to be his long-lost brother.

Intuition takes place with workaholic relationship therapist, Dr. David Francis, who tries to help Kenny deal with his trust issues. The Doctor fails to realize his patient is having an affair with his fiancé Karen.
When Drea gets kicked out of school, she turns to the streets to make some money. What she does not know is that fast money and life on the streets of Bissonnet come at a high price.
Released from prison, Mark makes the decision to change his ways. Kane has other plans in store for him.
Two undercover agents set out to track down a drug kingpin.
